insurer_name: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
residency_requirement: Indian resident; single sum insured covers entire family
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Grace 15 days for monthly mode, 30 days otherwise. PED 36 months. Specific 24/48 months by IRDAI list. Critical illness benefit defined.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Floater Sum Insured covers all members; standard New India sub-limits with room rent caps by SI band

day_care_treatments.limit_text: Listed day care procedures plus 12 Modern Treatments

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to 100% of Sum Insured for inpatient AYUSH

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Newborn (up to 90 days) cover linked to family policy

critical_illness_cover.limit_text: Defined CI list (cancer, MI, CABG, valve replacement, coma, kidney failure, stroke, organ transplant, paralysis, MND, MS) per Section 2.10

room_rent_capping: Sub-limit by SI plan (typically 1% of SI per day; ICU 2%)
copayment_trigger_notes: Zone-based co-pay may apply per schedule
notable_exclusions_summary: Floater plan for family. Maternity excluded. Standard IRDAI exclusion list applies. PED waiting 36 months. Critical-illness conditions defined per IRDAI standardisation.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via TPA at network hospital; pre-authorisation within 1 hour, final discharge approval within 3 hours per IRDAI 2024 norms. Reimbursement via document submission. Helpline 1800-209-1415. Migration and portability allowed.
